messages:
Dave (customer): Hi — seeing streaming tool-call args get cut mid-JSON when we use SSE through our gateway. Our app receives broken JSON and the tool call fails with schema validation. Example captured stream (raw chunks we logged):

```
> data: {"event":"response","id":1,"payload":{"tool_call":{"name":"charge","args":{"amount":100,"currency":"USD","order_id":"ord_abc123",
> data: "metadata":{"user":"u123","notes":"card on file"}}}}

# next chunk arrives
> data: "}
```

You can see the JSON is split so the second chunk is just a trailing quote+brace and ends up as invalid JSON when reassembled by our client. This only happens when streaming large arg objects. Not reproducible in single-shot responses.

Alice (support): Thanks — can you confirm which SDK/version and whether you proxy through nginx/cloudfront/ingress? Also can you paste the curl you used to reproduce?

Dave (customer): We use our JS frontend -> internal proxy (nginx) -> backend -> Redwood hosted API. SDK is r-inference-js v0.9.3 but happens direct via curl too. Repro curl we ran against our gateway (we captured raw tcp):

```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \  "https://api.our-gw.internal/v1/chat/stream"
```

Raw TCP capture of response (showing chunk boundaries):

```
0000: 4e\r\n
data: {"event":"response","payload":{..."args":{"big":"A... (first 8192 bytes)\r\n\r\n0001: 1f\r\n"metadata":{"user":"u123"}}}}\r\n\r\n0002: 0\r\n\r\n```

Ben (sre): This looks like typical chunked-transfer/user-agent buffering causing a split at an unfortunate byte boundary. Are you adding any response filters in nginx (like gzip, sub_filter) or proxy_buffering on? Cloudflare and some WAFs can also re-chunk.

Dave (customer): nginx proxy, default proxy_buffering on, no gzip on responses for SSE. No CDN.

Mia (engineer): If the runtime expects full JSON object per event, partial chunks will break naive parsers. Two mitigation paths:
- client: assemble SSE `data:` lines until a full JSON parse succeeds (NDJSON or bracket matching)
- server/runtime: always emit complete JSON per `data:` event or use an event framing protocol (e.g., `�` delimiter)

I can try to make the runtime more tolerant by buffering until matching braces, but need a small repro that we can run against a local proxy.

Ben (sre): I reproduced quickly with a tiny node streamer + nginx proxy. Repro steps:

1) node server that writes partial JSON with `res.write()` and `setTimeout` for spacing
2) nginx in front with `proxy_buffering on` (default)
3) curl -N shows split chunks like above

Node snippet I used:
```
const http = require('http');
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache'});
  res.write('data: {"id":1,"payload":{"tool_call":{"name":"x","args":{"a":"');
  setTimeout(() => res.write('LONG_PAYLOAD_PART","more":true}}}}

'), 50);
  setTimeout(() => res.end(), 100);
}).listen(9000);
```

Ben (sre): nginx fix I tested (reduced re-chunking):
```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 128k;
proxy_buffers 4 256k;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```
Turning `proxy_buffering off` made curl see larger contiguous writes. Not perfect but helps.

Carla (devex): Customer SDKs should also recommend robust SSE assembly. We'll add a note in the streaming docs: "Do not assume network chunk boundaries equal JSON boundaries; assemble `data:` lines before parsing." Could add example code for bracket-matching assembly.

Dave (customer): Quick question — is Redwood runtime able to reassemble broken JSON if the event `data:` lines are split? Or do we need to handle fully client-side?

Mia (engineer): Today the runtime treats each SSE `data:` event as a chunk and tries to parse JSON per event. If the SDK emits multiple `data:` lines per event it's okay, but if a single data line is split at the network layer it breaks. Short-term: handle assembly client-side (we can provide a helper). Long-term: we should make server emit smaller, validated per-event JSON or have the runtime reassemble across event boundaries.

Alice (support): Action items:
- Dave: enable header `X-RW-Debug: 1` and share a full raw tcp capture + request_id when next repro happens.
- Ben/Mia: eng-runtime to evaluate tolerant assembler or change emitter to guarantee per-event valid JSON.
- Carla: doc update + SDK helper snippet for SSE assembly.

Dave (customer): Uploaded tcpdump to the ticket and enabled debug. Added logs with request-id `req_0x9f3a`. Thanks. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Linked ticket RW-12345 to thread and notified eng-runtime oncall.

Mia (engineer): I'll spin up a small PR to add a defensive assembler in the runtime that tries to buffer until JSON parse succeeds (max 64kb) and falls back to current behavior if it times out. Posting a link when ready.

Alice (support): Thanks everyone — following up once eng-runtime has a patch or we have a recommended customer workaround.
